questions.q: More land is used for housing. What does composite demand suggest will happen to the market for farmland?
options: Less is available, so supply falls and its price tends to rise
More is available, so its price falls

questions.q: Explain why a fall in demand for new cars may reduce the wages of car workers.

ideas.label: Demand for labour is derived from demand for cars
Lower demand for labour pushes wages down

questions.model: Demand for car workers is derived from demand for cars. If fewer cars are wanted, firms need fewer workers, so demand for labour shifts left and wages tend to fall.
questions.why: Labour is wanted for what it produces.

tests.answer: Demand for labour is derived from cars so firms need fewer workers, which pushes wages down.
Demand for labour is a derived demand.
